classification.difficultyReason: Exponential growth and decay from two data points, with logs for a time. Part c needs k from the initial rate. Routine but with a few linked decisions.

content.prompt: Each quantity below changes at a rate proportional to the amount present.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
A population of rabbits on an island is 400 initially and 600 after 2 years.

Find the time taken for the population to reach 2000, to one decimal place.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{dN}{dt}&=kN\\\frac{dN}{N}&=k\,dt\\\ln|N|&=kt+C\\N&=Ae^{kt}\end{aligned}$$
$N(0)=400$ gives $A=400$.
$$\begin{aligned}600&=400e^{2k}\\e^{2k}&=\frac32\\k&=\frac12\ln\frac32\end{aligned}$$
Set $N=2000$:
$$\begin{aligned}2000&=400e^{kt}\\e^{kt}&=5\\t&=\frac{\ln5}{k}=\frac{2\ln5}{\ln1.5}\approx7.9.\end{aligned}$$
It takes about $7.9$ years.

children.label: b
children.prompt:
The value $V$ of a delivery van, $t$ years after it was bought, decreases. After 1 year it is worth $\$36\,000$ and after 3 years it is worth $\$25\,000$.

Find its value when new.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{dV}{dt}&=kV\\V&=Ae^{kt}\end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{aligned}36\,000&=Ae^{k}\\25\,000&=Ae^{3k}\end{aligned}$$
Dividing:
$$\begin{aligned}e^{2k}&=\frac{25}{36}\\e^{k}&=\frac56\\A&=36\,000\times\frac65=43\,200.\end{aligned}$$
The van was worth $\$43\,200$ when new.

children.label: c
children.prompt:
A sample of radioactive material has mass $M$ grams at time $t$ days. Initially $M=250$ and the mass is decreasing at 15 grams per day.

Find the mass after 10 days, to one decimal place.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{dM}{dt}&=kM\\M&=250e^{kt}\end{aligned}$$
At $t=0$, $\dfrac{dM}{dt}=-15$:
$$\begin{aligned}-15&=250k\\k&=-0.06\end{aligned}$$
$$M(10)=250e^{-0.6}\approx137.2.$$
The mass is about $137.2$ g.
